digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center test fixture licensing and provenance
propositions: The vendored Jira Data Center Dockerfile lacks upstream source revision, license identifier, protected license text, and modification statement in its comment header.

The Dockerfile comment header must be updated to record the pycontribs/jira repository, commit e3c7b167b065660605645cef7f101cbb324772e4, source path docker/jira-test-image/Dockerfile, and BSD-2-Clause license identifier.

The upstream root LICENSE from the specified commit must be stored unchanged in tests/external/live_jira_dc/pycontribs-jira-LICENSE.txt with SHA-256 digest a432e25d7fa27b288cc7ab6ea8e3a9aa27c101579de7fad7a3b5f534ba9e772a.
A unit assertion in tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_jira_dc_harness_shape.py must verify the stored license bytes match the expected SHA-256 digest without network or harness access.
Local modifications (product.start.timeout flag and expanded annotations) must be documented while preserving all Dockerfile instructions, base digest, Jira version, and exposed port.
Documentation in tests/external/live_jira_dc/README.md must distinguish upstream source licensing from Atlassian product licensing.
